mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (relative to prior quarter), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) indicates an overheated labor market under restrictive monetary policy, which increases the risk of a recession and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% AND FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0), the manufacturing sector contraction signals weakening economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate central bank stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly core CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1500.0) and industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate policy easing.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 0.5% monthly), rising retail sales boost corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
